prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: SaaS服务合同新旧条款对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "条款号" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 62px
  col 2: header "原文" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 1563px
  col 3: header "修订后" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 3232px
  col 4: header "修订说明" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 1425px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对照SaaS服务合同各条款的原文、修订后文本和修订说明，帮助读者理解变更。","reading":"读者先按条款号定位，再横向比较原文与修订后文本，最后查看修订说明；同一行应保持清晰的对应关系。手机宽度下，长条款会形成高行，较短单元格可利用同一行的高度换行。","groups":["原文与修订后是直接对照的一组，宽度应支持逐行比较；修订后内容更长，可按策略给予更多空间。","修订说明与两版条款同属一行，解释该条变更；条款号则承担定位作用。"],"keep_intact":["条款号，如第3.1条、第12.4条","数字、编号及合同中的专有名称应尽可能保持完整"],"may_wrap":["原文和修订后文本可按中文语义自然换行","修订说明可自然换行","表头可在必要时换行，但应保持易辨认"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [83, 76, 119, 81] · table 360×3962px · row heights [60, 827, 687, 804, 850, 734] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 36 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1B: widths [83, 87, 108, 81] · table 360×4287px · row heights [60, 687, 734, 943, 1013, 850] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 43 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r1C: widths [83, 65, 130, 81] · table 360×4218px · row heights [60, 1245, 687, 804, 757, 664] · column headers wrapped 1/4 · tallest cell 53 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"三种方案中整体高度最短，原文与修订后都有可辨认的文字块，逐条横向对照较顺畅。条款号完整，修订说明与对应条款同处一行。","problems":"原文仍显狭窄，部分短句被切成很多短行；修订说明表头换行，且较短单元格下方留有大片空白。长行中的横向对应关系需要靠边框维持。","cause":"原文列宽76px，仅有55px文字宽度；修订后119px承担更长的文本并决定多数行高。修订说明81px容纳四字表头较紧。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"原文列较宽，第一条原文的换行节奏比r1A舒展；条款号完整，列间角色清楚。","problems":"修订后文本形成很长的窄文字带，尤其后几条拉高整行，使原文和说明下方出现更多空白，跨列比较更费力。","cause":"修订后列从119px缩至108px，文字空间减少，而该列内容最长；原文增加的11px未能抵消修订后列增加的行高。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"修订后列更宽，后几条的修订文本相对舒展，部分行高较r1A降低；条款号仍保持完整。","problems":"原文列过窄，第一条几乎成为逐字向下的长条，显著拉高该行，也破坏了两版文本的对照平衡。","cause":"原文列仅65px，扣除边距和边框后只剩44px文字宽度；给修订后增加的宽度以原文过度拥挤为代价。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"A-修订微增","widths":[83,73,122,81],"change":"以r1A为基础，将3px从原文移给修订后，测试能否缩短主要由修订后决定的行，同时避免重现r1C的原文拥挤。"},{"name":"A-原文微增","widths":[83,79,116,81],"change":"从修订后移3px给原文，检验原文的阅读节奏能否改善，以及修订后增加的换行是否仍可接受。"},{"name":"压缩说明","widths":[83,81,124,71],"change":"将修订说明缩窄10px，分配给两列合同正文，让直接对照的两版都获得更多空间；重点检查说明列的可读性和它是否开始主导行高。"}]}
